title.zh: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
title.en: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case

current_state.zh: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee that the prediction market's sports-event contracts fall under state gambling law rather than CFTC swap jurisdiction, deepening a circuit split and raising the likelihood of Supreme Court review.
current_state.en: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee that the prediction market's sports-event contracts fall under state gambling law rather than CFTC swap jurisdiction, deepening a circuit split and raising the likelihood of Supreme Court review.
